description: This Java source file implements the VoicemailProviderHelpers class, which provides methods to interact with voicemail data via a content provider, including inserting, updating, querying, and deleting voicemails, as well as managing voicemail content streams.

classes.name: VoicemailProviderHelpers
classes.description: A final class implementing VoicemailProviderHelper, providing methods to manage voicemail data through a content provider, including CRUD operations and content stream handling.

methods.name: createFullVoicemailProvider
methods.description: Creates a VoicemailProviderHelper with full access to all voicemails, requiring specific permissions.

methods.name: createPackageScopedVoicemailProvider
methods.description: Creates a VoicemailProviderHelper scoped to the application's package, requiring specific permissions.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new Voicemail object into the content provider.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing voicemail identified by URI with new data.

methods.name: setVoicemailContent
methods.description: Sets the content of a voicemail from an InputStream or byte array, updating MIME type and content status.

methods.name: findVoicemailBySourceData
methods.description: Retrieves a Voicemail by its source data string.

methods.name: findVoicemailByUri
methods.description: Retrieves a Voicemail by its URI, ensuring an exact match.

methods.name: getUriForVoicemailWithId
methods.description: Generates a URI for a voicemail given its ID.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all voicemails from the content provider.

methods.name: getAllVoicemails
methods.description: Retrieves all voicemails, optionally filtered and sorted.

methods.name: getAllVoicemails
methods.description: Overloaded method to retrieve all voicemails with filtering and sorting options.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Asserts a condition, throwing IllegalArgumentException if false, with message including voicemail details.
